matter_background.original: Kamal Rathnayaka is a Notary practicing in Galle. Sudath Gunawardana is a neighbour of Kamal Ratnayake and the owner of a commercial building in Colombo. He is an illiterate individual. Sudath wishes to lease out his commercial building for 4 years at a monthly rental of Rs. 60,000/- and Kapila Warnakulasooriya is ready to take on lease in accordance with the said terms.
